title: Mrs. Flora Anderson

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S.1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. S. B. REGISTRY
No. S. D. D.
Date Sept. 25, 1939.
Subject Mrs. Flora Anderson
Made by D.P.S. Killingbeck Forwarded by R. O. M.

In connection with the attached enquiry
regarding a Mrs. Flora Anderson, enquiries reveal
that this person arrived in Shanghai, from Vienna,
on October 18, 1938, on board the s.s. "Conte
Biancamano."

Arrangements were made for Mrs. Anderson
and her child to obtain accommodation at "Henley
House", a private residential hotel, 1094 Avenue Road,
by Dr. Peritz, local German Jewish refugee. It is
not known whether Mrs. Anderson is acquainted with
Dr. Peritz, as it is alleged that Dr. Peritz has on
numerous occasions given assistance to all manner
of people in Shanghai.

Mrs. Anderson and her young son have resided
at Henley House ever since October 18 and are at
present still there. Mrs. Anderson is reputed to
be a gymnastic instructress and at one time was
engaged in conducting a gymnastic class in Shanghai.
She has also been mentioned in various local newspapers
and magazines in connection with her activities in this
sphere. She does not have many foreign friends in
Shanghai, although she exchanges the usual courtesies
with other residents at "Henley House."

It is stated that when war was declared
between Great Britain and Germany, Mrs. Anderson,
who is an Aryan German was very upset and worried
about her future status locally. She was assured
by the Manageress of "Henley House" that she would not

事由 弗洛拉·安德森夫人（Mrs. Flora Anderson）
制作人 副警务总监基林贝克（D.P.S. Killingbeck） 转呈人 R. O. M.

就随附的关于弗洛拉·安德森夫人的查询而言，经查证，
此人于1938年10月18日乘坐“比安卡马诺伯爵”号轮船（s.s. "Conte
Biancamano"）从维也纳抵达上海。

当地德裔犹太难民佩里茨博士（Dr. Peritz）已为安德森
夫人及其子女在爱文义路1094号的私人公寓式旅馆“亨利之家”
（Henley House）安排了住宿。目前尚不清楚安德森夫人与
佩里茨博士是否相识，据称佩里茨博士曾多次向在上海的各类人士提供援助。

自10月18日以来，安德森夫人和她年幼的儿子一直居住在
亨利之家，目前仍住在那里。安德森夫人据称是一名体操教练，曾一度
在上海开设体操班。她在这一领域的活动也曾被当地多家报纸
和杂志提及。她在上海的外国朋友不多，尽管她与“亨利之家”的其他住客保持着一般的礼节性往来。

据说，当英国与德国宣战时，身为雅利安德国人的安德森夫人对其在当地的未来地位感到非常不安和担忧。“亨利之家”的女经理向她保证，她不会受到

be treated any differently by the management of the establishment. She is treated well by all residents of the boarding house but is very quiet and reserved. She frequently has Chinese friends call on her at "Henley House" and employs a young Chinese woman to look after her child. This woman is not of the usual "amah" type and Mrs. Anderson has brought her child into the habit of calling this woman "Auntie." The manageress of "Henley House" has expressed her annoyance with various of Mrs. Anderson's habits, saying that she objects to foreigners "going native."

During June of the current year, when Kao Shing Pao (高鑫寶), manager of the Lido Ballroom was arrested for alleged guerilla activities, Mrs. Anderson was heard to remark that her sister was a friend of Kao Shing Pao. It has been rumoured that Mrs. Anderson's sister, whose name is believed to be "Mrs. Meyer," is employed by the Chinese Government, but this is only according to "boarding house chatter." "Mrs. Meyer" is not known at "Henley House" and no information as to her present whereabouts is available. A considerable amount of mail is addressed to Mrs. Anderson at "Henley House" but the source is not known.

A short while ago, a German Aryan named Rettberg resided at 1094 Avenue Road and this man was regarded by residents as a very doubtful

受到该机构管理层的区别对待。寄宿公寓的所有住客都对她很好，但她非常安静且矜持。经常有中国朋友到“亨利之家”拜访她，她还雇佣了一名年轻的中国女性照顾她的孩子。这名女子并非通常意义上的“阿妈”（amah）类型，安德森夫人已让她的孩子习惯称呼这名女子为“阿姨”。“亨利之家”的女经理对安德森夫人的各种习惯表示不满，称她反对外国人“变得本土化”。

在今年六月，当丽都舞厅（Lido Ballroom）经理高鑫宝因涉嫌游击队活动被捕时，有人听到安德森夫人评论说她的姐姐是高鑫宝的朋友。有谣言称，安德森夫人的姐姐（据信名为“迈耶夫人”）受雇于中国政府，但这仅是“寄宿公寓里的闲谈”。“迈耶夫人”在“亨利之家”无人知晓，目前也无从其下落得知任何信息。有大量邮件寄往“亨利之家”的安德森夫人，但来源不明。

不久前，一名名叫雷特伯格（Rettberg）的雅利安德国人居住在爱文义路1094号，住客们认为此人品行十分可疑

character. Some time after war was declared, he
left 1094 Avenue Road, stating that he was taking
up residence in Hongkew, but it is thought that
he returned to Germany. Mrs. Anderson was
apparently no more friendly with Rettberg than with
the other residents of "Henley House".
On September 4, 1939, Mrs. Anderson engaged
a room at the Park Hotel but has never resided there.
She pays for the room regularly and has possession of
the key. Since September 4, many cablegrams, on some days
as many as three, have arrived at the Park Hotel for
Mrs. Anderson, mostly addressed to the telegraphic
address "THIRX." Mrs. Anderson usually calls at the
Park Hotel personally, but occasionally a woman who
states that she is Mrs. Anderson's sister, calls for the
mail. Mrs. Anderson registered at the Park Hotel as
Mrs. E.H. Anderson and child, Customs House.
Mrs. Anderson has told the manageress of
"Henley House" that her husband was employed in the
Maritime Customs in Shanghai, but he is not known
at "Henley House" and has not resided with Mrs.
Anderson since her arrival in Shanghai. It is not
known whether any of Mrs. Anderson's correspondence
is from her husband, but the arrival of letters at
"Henley House" appear to affect Mrs. Anderson's
financial resources. It is stated that at times
she appears to be very short of money and then

离开了爱文义路1094号，声称要搬去虹口居住，但据信
他已返回德国。显然，安德森夫人与雷特伯格的关系
并不比她与“亨利之家”其他住客的关系更友好。
1939年9月4日，安德森夫人在国际饭店（Park Hotel）预订了一个房间，但从未在此居住。
她定期支付房费并持有钥匙。自9月4日以来，许多电报，有时一天多达三封，陆续寄达国际饭店给安德森夫人，大多使用电报挂号地址“THIRX”。安德森夫人通常亲自前往国际饭店领取，但偶尔也有一名自称是安德森夫人姐姐的女子代为领取邮件。安德森夫人在国际饭店登记的名字为 E.H. 安德森夫人及子女，职业为海关职员。
安德森夫人曾告诉“亨利之家”的女经理，她的丈夫在上海海关任职，但“亨利之家”无人认识他，且自安德森夫人抵达上海以来，他并未与她同住。目前尚不清楚安德森夫人的信件中是否有来自其丈夫的，但寄到“亨利之家”的信件似乎影响了安德森夫人的财务状况。据说她有时显得非常缺钱，然后

She is a good boarder at "Henley house"
and pays her accounts regularly.
Mrs. Anderson, who is described as a rather
dull, unintelligent type of person, is listed on
C.S.6 records as, "Flora Anderson, German, Housewife,
aged 33 in 1938. Arrived prior to October, 1938."
Mrs. Anderson's husband is believed to be
of Swedish-American descent.

她是“亨利之家”的好住客，定期结清账目。
安德森夫人被描述为一个相当迟钝、缺乏智慧的人，在 C.S.6 记录中列为：“弗洛拉·安德森，德国人，家庭主妇，1938年时33岁。1938年10月前抵达。”
据信安德森夫人的丈夫具有瑞典裔美国人血统。

Y.
